title_cn: 我们可以相信选举预测市场吗？

But a new Bloomberg investigation has found evidence that these markets are vulnerable to manipulation. On today’s Big Take podcast, host Sarah Holder and Bloomberg investigative reporter Liam Vaughan dig into what can happen when prediction markets mix with politics.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Meta Gives Lackluster Quarterly Sales Forecast
title_cn: Meta 给出的季度销售预测黯淡
summary: Meta Platforms Inc. gave a disappointing revenue forecast for the current quarter, intensifying investor concerns about the social media giant’s spending on artificial intelligence. Bloomberg News Big Tech Team Leader Kurt Wagner says as long as Meta is making money and the core business is going, they can get away with aggressive AI spending on data centers. He argues, however, that the minute worry sets in of a potential slowdown on its core advertising business investors start to question if the company should be spending so much on infrastructure. Plus, a viewer question on Meta's capex spending. Bloomberg.com and Terminal subscribers can send in their questions for Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec to ask guests live on-air. Just go to Bloomberg.com/askradio  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Microsoft’s Cloud Accelerates to Fastest Growth Since 2022
title_cn: 微软云加速实现 2022 年以来最快增长
summary:
Microsoft cloud unit grew at the fastest pace in four years, suggesting that the company’s computing infrastructure and artificial intelligence services continue to make inroads with businesses.
Azure cloud-computing revenue increased 43% during the fiscal fourth quarter, the company said Wednesday in a statement. That was the fastest quarterly growth since early 2022, and topped analysts’ average growth estimate of about 40%. Azure sales topped $100 billion for the first time during the fiscal year ended in June. 
Bloomberg Tech Host Ed Ludlow reacts to earnings (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Why Moonshot's Kimi K3 Matters Beyond China

summary: Moonshot's Kimi K3 has reignited debate over China's role in the AI race, but Beringea Chief Investment Officer Karen McCormick says the bigger story is the growing availability of cheaper, open-weight AI models. She joins Bloomberg to explain why lower-cost AI is helping startups build faster, forcing frontier model providers to stay competitive, and accelerating AI adoption across industries. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

Noto joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Sen. Kennedy: Iran Pressure Campaign Will Be 'Painful'

The Louisiana Republican calls inflation "pernicious" and says the Federal Reserve will have to raise rates if it is not brought under control. Sen. Kennedy also says that, "if I had to bet," the Senate Judiciary Committee will not vote on Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general tomorrow. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

While it performs many of the same functions as its global counterparts — responding to emergencies at sea and enforcing maritime law in its jurisdiction — it is increasingly being used for a different purpose: advancing Beijing’s territorial claims.

title: Fed Holds Rates, Three Officials Dissent in Favor of Hike: Fed Special

summary: The Federal Reserve held rates steady as the majority of FOMC members voted to hold rates unchanged, with three members dissenting in favor of a rate hike. This is the fifth straight meeting where fed officials have elected to leave rates unchanged. Talking to reporters, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reiterated his goal to bring down inflation and but stopped short of saying he would raise rates.  Warsh said raising rates 'could well be part of that solution,' but not in isolation. Bloomberg's Tom Keene, Jon Ferro and Lisa Abramowicz discuss remarks from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh following the Federal Reserve's latest policy decision on a special edition of Bloomberg Surveillance. (Source: Bloomberg)

title_cn: 美联储沃什表示没有软通胀目标
summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh says the fight to bring down inflation has just begun. “Let me reiterate: there is no soft inflation target, there is no soft implicit target, not on this committee’s watch," he said during a press conference in Washington. Warsh says "there's only a target, and it's 2%." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Saudi Attack on Iraq: Who are the Popular Mobilization Forces (PMF)?
title_cn: 沙特袭击伊拉克：谁是人民动员力量（PMF）？
summary: A new line of fighting in the war in the Middle East opened up on July 28 when Saudi Arabia launched an attack on Iraq, with which the kingdom has generally cordial relations. The strike, carried out in conjunction with US forces, targeted Iranian-backed militants in Iraq who, the Saudis said, had fired drones at Saudi oil facilities two days in a row.

title: Fed Holds Rates Steady, Three Dissenters Wanted a Hike
title_cn: 美联储维持利率稳定，三名反对者希望加息
summary: The Federal Reserve voted to hold interest rates unchanged in a range of 3.5% to 3.75%, with some officials dissenting in favor of raising rates by a quarter percentage point. The vote was 9-3. Bloomberg's Michael McKee reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: NextEra, Brookfield Plan $100B Hub | Balance of Power 7/29/2026
title_cn: NextEra，Brookfield 计划 $100B 中心 |权力平衡 7/29/2026
summary: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz discuss the latest from the Trump Administration. On today's show, US Energy Secretary Chris Wright, Harvard Kennedy School Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino and American Principles Project Political Director Katie Frost. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Mamdani Stands by Pied-à-Terre Rollout Despite Backlash
title_cn: 尽管遭到强烈反对，马姆达尼仍坚持推出临时住所
summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani defended the rollout of a new tax on highly valued second homes in New York City, saying only property owners who receive a letter from city officials will be impacted by the levy.
